reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding; nothing is raised as a negotiation issue.

The cited paragraphs support the compliance call: variable fees are a percentage of Application Management Revenue actually received from Customers (p0157), implementation is time-and-materials against an agreed SOW with a cap (p0161), and seat volume is 'Unlimited' rather than a committed minimum (p0151) — i.e. fees for usage/ordered services only, the preferred position.

The only 'minimum' language in scope (p0158, 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer) is correctly read as a qualifying threshold on a royalty-free-license fee waiver that benefits our side, not a purchase obligation, so it is properly not flagged.

Annual maintenance/access fees over the five-year term are correctly characterised as fees conditioned on continued payment (p0055) rather than take-or-pay or shortfall exposure; noting this in the rationale rather than flagging it matches the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements.
No deterministic check failures and no unnecessary edits; the finding is properly retained as internal evidence.
